attempts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset: ONE new PRIMARY LOGO SYMBOL for the personal website Little Stone Still Here (LSSH). No other assets.
The previous design was rejected: a heavy letter L with an unrelated floating little square, badly balanced empty space and a shallow literal metaphor. Completely rethink that construction. Do NOT render a literal L with a dot or square.

Meaning that must be inherent in the construction: "Absence leaves a precise trace. Something can be gone and still shape the place it occupied." This is the core of a personal archive: the person is not online, but what remains makes them felt. The concept connects to memory and presence, not a literal rock illustration.

Solve this as a rigorously minimal positive/negative-space emblem, using only TWO solid geometric parts and one intentional cavity. A small displaced piece and the exact matching recess it leaves must visibly belong to the same original whole. The recess must have its own very clear simple silhouette. The remaining larger body should feel balanced and compact, NOT like a tall heavy letter L. Design the removed piece and its remembered empty position as an equal visual relationship, not a dot arbitrarily added beside a symbol. The viewer should feel a complete shape even though the piece has shifted slightly. Consider a compact nearly square or softly chamfered solid, with a small but substantial square part displaced at one corner along a single deliberate axis; use the black channel between the two pieces to express that time has passed. Let the shared contour and closure do all the conceptual work. Keep the piece close enough for the original whole to be inferred, far enough for the vacancy to be real. Do not make an assembly diagram or a jigsaw puzzle. No instructions, arrows or motion trails.

Formal priorities:
A single beautiful compact outer silhouette. At most 2 simple white components. The little element around one-third the width of the whole, never a tiny accent dot. A crisp and optically balanced open black counterform; controlled generous separation, no pinched slits, no accidental near-tangencies. One consistent corner treatment, minimally softened, refined broad proportions. No squishy organic curves. No decorative additions. The idea must survive removal of every word.

Render as pure uniform flat WHITE on pure flat BLACK, a precise 2D graphic ink mark, no paper or surface texture, no cream color, no shading, no gradients, no 3D. Square black canvas, a single optically centered symbol around 45 percent of the width with very generous space. NO letters, no wordmark, no title, no rationale text, no captions, no border, no presentation sheet, no multiple versions. Avoid house, upload, document, app-grid, generic broken-square technology icon, furniture, bricks, cartoon stones, plants and beans. The final image is only the newly resolved mark.

Use case: logo-brand.
Make ONE primary logo only for Little Stone Still Here. The conceptual structure is RECURSIVE PRESENCE: a visible L leaves an identically proportioned smaller L in the empty space. The person and their remembered trace share the same shape. A small solid square, the Little Stone, is what makes this second L appear. The black negative space is as designed as the white ink. This is a compact positive/negative graphic, not a letter with a decorative floating dot.

The precise composition matters. Think of an invisible 9 by 9 square:
- A WHITE large L occupies the full left three units (x 0 to 3, y 0 to 9) and the bottom three units (x 0 to 9, y 6 to 9). One connected L, equal horizontal and vertical weight, square overall proportions.
- A WHITE small square occupies the upper-right four by four units (x 5 to 9, y 0 to 4). Its TOP and RIGHT edges align exactly with the large L's outer square envelope.
- The BLACK space between them MUST read as a SECOND complete L: x 3 to 5, y 0 to 6, plus x 3 to 9, y 4 to 6. This smaller black L has side length 6 and stroke width 2, exactly the same proportions as the side-9 stroke-3 white L. That is the entire visual idea.
- Do not draw the grid, measurements, outlines, or an outer container. The black L is open to the surrounding black background at its upper edge and right edge.
- Keep the small square completely inside the 9x9 envelope. It is not floating above, right of, or outside the mark. Equal width black channels, no pinched slits.
- Preserve these ratios closely. Only tiny optical easing of corners (about 2% of the full symbol width), not round or pillowy forms. A precise, economical, calm modern emblem, very slightly softened.

PURE FLAT WHITE ink, PURE FLAT BLACK canvas. Binary graphic appearance. Absolutely no beige, texture, gradients, shadows, bevels, highlights or 3D. No transparency. No letters or captions except the implicit L-shaped geometry described above. No wordmark, no mockup, no poster layout, no border, no alternate versions, no explanations. Show the ONE completed logo optically centered on a square canvas, about 44 percent of canvas width, with generous empty space. Focus on extraordinary precision of shared contour and balanced figure-ground.
